snippet.title: Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers, a first-person horror thriller game developed by Dead Witness. 

Players will embody a reserve keeper after the three original keepers of the Eilean Mor lighthouse have gone missing. Investigate the sinister plot and don't become the fourth lost keeper in Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and PC (Steam).

#Gametrailers #EileanMorTheLostKeepers #Horror
